Mayo Investment Advisers Maintains Position in Macom Tech Solutions Holdings (MTSI); Pentwater Capital Management LP Lowered Its Synchrony Financial (SYF) Stake by $4.47 Million as Stock Price Declined 
April 3, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade 
Matthew Halbower decreased its stake in Synchrony Financial (SYF) by 5.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pentwater Capital Management Lp sold 117,651 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.73% with the market. The hedge fund run by Matthew Halbower held 1.96M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $75.85 million, down from 2.08M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pentwater Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Synchrony Financial for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $25.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.64% or $0.535   $33.195. About 2.71 million shares traded. Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) has declined 0.21%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.76% the S&P500. 
Mayo Investment Advisers Llc increased its stake in Macom Tech Solutions Holdings (MTSI) by 19.08% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mayo Investment Advisers Llc bought 20,450 shares as the company’s stock declined 50.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 127,650 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.15M, up from 107,200 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mayo Investment Advisers Llc who had been investing in Macom Tech Solutions Holdings for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.49% or $0.08   $16.25. About 934,927 shares traded. MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:MTSI) has declined 63.40%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 74.95% the S&P500. 
Pentwater Capital Management Lp, which manages about $5.28B and $15.03 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Advanced Accelerator Application by 18,000 shares to 80,000 shares, valued at $6.53M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM) by 12.58 million shares in the quarter, for a total of 13.91 million shares, and has risen its stake in Silverbow Res Inc. 
Analysts await Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) to report earnings on April, 27. They expect $0.79 earnings per share, up 29.51% or $0.18 from last year’s $0.61 per share. SYF’s profit will be $600.56 million for 10.50 P/E if the $0.79 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.70 actual earnings per share reported by Synchrony Financial for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 12.86% EPS growth. 
Among 29 analysts covering Synchrony Financial ( NYSE:SYF ), 22 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 76% are positive. The rating was maintained by Citigroup on Wednesday, June 15 with “Buy”. As per Thursday, December 28, the company rating was maintained by Susquehanna. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, May 31 by BMO Capital Markets.

It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 24,913 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 38,350 shares, and cut its stake in Acacia Communications Inc..
